LanguageData.TMM.VehicleRaid.LetterText: Hostile forces from {0} are rolling into the area in {1} armored vehicle(s)!\n\nThey will drive to a staging point near the colony, dismount their assault squad, and press the attack. If you neutralize the crew without destroying a vehicle, you can claim it as a trophy.
LanguageData.TMM.VehicleVisit.LetterText: A friendly trade crew from {0} has arrived in a {1}.\n\nOnce parked, their trader will step out to trade directly from the vehicle's cargo bay before driving back into the wasteland.
LanguageData.TMM.VehicleRaid.ClaimDesc: Take ownership of this abandoned {0} for the colony.
